summary: Inline review: the plugin structure and source reuse fit the workspace, but API feasibility, credential protection, and live-write validation need substantive changes. Instagram endpoint evidence was accepted as supplied; no authenticated Instagram requests were made.
strengths: Manifest layout, self-contained TypeScript scripts, and Bun invocation match the reference plugins.
Named source scripts exist, and the Jake Schincariol/Corey Haines MIT attributions check out.
Dry-run defaults, explicit publishing approval, missing-metric labels, and separation from Ads Manager are sensible.

blocking_findings.title: 0600 does not provide Windows credential isolation
blocking_findings.why: Define and verify Windows ACL protection for cookies and the persistent Chrome profile. Logout must specify whether it removes both; deleting cookies.json alone leaves reusable browser credentials.
blocking_findings.evidence: The plan promises 0600 under APPDATA. The NotebookLM reference writes plaintext and explicitly ignores chmod failures on Windows. Node documents that owner/group permission distinctions are unsupported there: [filesystem documentation](https://nodejs.org/api/fs.html#file-modes).

blocking_findings.title: REST fallbacks do not resolve the demonstrated read failures
blocking_findings.why: Core reads underpin audit and research, but the plan supplies no working transport for several of them. Specify GraphQL operation discovery, variables, pagination, response parsing, and explicit unsupported-operation behavior before building dependent skills.
blocking_findings.evidence: The supplied probes report 404s, 429s, and non-JSON responses, and acknowledge rotating GraphQL doc_ids. Nevertheless, endpoints.ts is defined exclusively as REST paths/hosts. A mobile API hostname is not automatically interchangeable with a browser-cookie request.

blocking_findings.title: Mutation contracts remain unestablished
blocking_findings.why: Endpoint strings cannot establish working publications. Define numeric timestamp-style upload_ids, distinct entity names, photo source/dimension fields, ordered children_metadata and sidecar flags, and separate story photo/video bodies. Delete and comment/reply also need verified web contracts; mobile routes and modern web GraphQL mutations cannot be substituted blindly.
blocking_findings.evidence: Only clips fields are enumerated; photo, carousel, story, delete, and comment bodies are absent. [Photo/story source](https://github.com/subzeroid/instagrapi/blob/master/instagrapi/mixins/photo.py) and [sidecar source](https://github.com/subzeroid/instagrapi/blob/master/instagrapi/mixins/album.py) illustrate the distinct contracts, but are mobile implementations, not verification of this web flow.

blocking_findings.title: Live-test privacy and write recovery are not established
blocking_findings.why: Do not assume archive_only makes a photo test invisible. Use an explicitly approved test account, bind approval to account/media, verify resulting visibility and deletion, and retain recovery identifiers. Bound transcode polling and reconcile ambiguous configure timeouts before retrying to prevent duplicates.
blocking_findings.evidence: archive_only was observed only among clips fields, yet the live test applies it to a photo. The sole publication test cannot validate carousel, reel, story, or comment behavior; no timeout/reconciliation or failed-cleanup acceptance criteria are defined. The explicit first-write approval requirement is good but does not resolve these risks.

non_blocking_findings.title: Account-stop and credential-boundary rules need executable tests
non_blocking_findings.why: Resolve 429 backoff versus immediate stop. Test that probes/fallbacks stop on challenges, dry runs send zero mutations, secrets are redacted, and authenticated requests cannot follow arbitrary input URLs or redirects.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The plan specifies both 429 backoff and immediate termination, and both exact-request previews and never printing cookies. It omits explicit X-IG-WWW-Claim refresh, required cookie validation, and host-scoping rules.

non_blocking_findings.title: Validation limits need reconciliation
non_blocking_findings.why: The 30-hashtag allowance conflicts with the supplied marketing reference's five-hashtag limit. Distinguish conservative CLI restrictions from verified endpoint limits, and cover story geometry, carousel cropping, byte limits, and video codecs; MP4 dimensions/duration alone do not establish compatibility.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Validation lists feed aspect ratios and reel duration but omits story-specific rules and codec checks. The supplied platform-limits reference explicitly lists five hashtags.

non_blocking_findings.title: Type-checking and Windows execution prerequisites are incomplete
non_blocking_findings.why: Declare development-only TypeScript tooling/typings and smoke-test quoted Windows paths and invocation outside the repository directory. Bun supports Windows, but executing TypeScript does not supply the proposed tsc check.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: npx and Git Bash are available locally; bun and tsc are absent from PATH. npx can supply Bun, but no TypeScript development setup is planned. [Bun installation documentation](https://bun.sh/docs/installation) confirms Windows support.

open_questions: Can sanitized request/response fixtures establish web-specific headers, payload encodings, and pagination without retaining cookies or account identifiers?
Which capabilities must be proven before release, and which will remain explicitly experimental until approved live tests pass?
Are posting-hour recommendations intended as descriptive correlations? Sample size, timezone, and uncertainty are currently unspecified.
